name: AWA Blood Is Thicker Than Water

date.source: The page's own header: "Date of Event: September 25th, 2005".

matches.note: Stryker took the win after hitting Stellar with brass knuckles while referee Johnny X was down; Stellar was making his AWA debut.
Referee Jason Margolis was down when Guardian hit his own manager Mr. Mike; Wilkins rolled Guardian up. Guardian and Mr. Mike beat Wilkins down afterward.

matches.stipulation: Hardcore match, taken through the backstage area and the boiler room
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-chaos
matches.note: Hunter Davis hit The Rumbler with a kendo stick in his own VIP room; Rumbler won after sending J Sane through two tables ten feet below. The ring announcer then calls him the Chaos champion.

matches.stipulation: Fem-X title, special referee Rick Young
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-fem-x
matches.note: Special referee Rick Young counted one on Brandi's cover, pulled her off, helped Tiffany up and hit her with a Sensation Driver; Brandi covered and Rick counted the three, then took off his wedding ring, dropped it on Tiffany and left with Brandi.

matches.stipulation: Champion vs champion unification, finishers only
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-unified
matches.note: Sensation took the X and Prime Time belts with a sit-down powerbomb from the top rope; Lexus Malone books Angela a no-DQ rematch on the new Sunday show.

matches.stipulation: Continental title; Cody Carson at ringside declares it no rules
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-continental
matches.note: Carson set up a ladder; Manson won with Synthesthesia after Cantina's Dragon screws, and Carson handed him the Continental title and half the tag belts.

matches.stipulation: World title, billed as a ladder match
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-world-heavyweight
matches.note: Rick Young stood at Mike's side and told the referee of Carson's feet on the ropes on an earlier cover; Carson won with a falling DDT and a 450 splash, and Rick walked out on his brother.

appearances.note: Special referee for Tiffany Phoenix against Brandi James; also at ringside for his brother Mike Young.
Opens the show as its new boss and appears in two backstage scenes.
Hits The Rumbler with a kendo stick during the Chaos title match.
At ringside with Hell's Guardian; holds Alex Wilkins and is hit by Guardian.

notes: Segments written by several hands on one page: the script keeps template slots ('Segment Name Here') and an unlinked foot-massage skit between the contenders' matches. Jimmy Stryker sits at commentary for the Fem-X match.

name: AWA Saturday Night Adrenaline #5

date.source: The page's own header: "Date of Event: November 19th, 2005", edition 5.

matches.note: Manson stayed away to renegotiate his contract and Maxwell Williams gave Ryba the win from the ring.
Tiffany Phoenix came down yelling at Aspen, then jumped on the apron and helped Skylar roll Aspen up in a schoolboy behind the referee's back; the commentary then calls Skylar the Fem-X champion.
Ridge Perkins did not appear; Lexus Malone announced a match of Angela's choice at the next pay-per-view, and Angela was given the count-out win.
Jalie Thomas came down to Seth's corner; Seth hit three suplexes and won with the Muerte Lenta submission, after which Jalie raised his arm.
Rick Young interfered and hit Mike through an announce table; Brandi won with Foreplay, a corkscrew moonsault, after a chair shot.
Stryker won after his finisher from the turnbuckle.
Jalie faked an injury, hit a low blow, then won with a corkscrew plancha and lionsault.

Brandi James said Rick was too sick to wrestle; Carson, refereeing, called for the bell, hit Rick with his own finisher, Your Resolution, and a chop to the throat, and counted the three with Adonis lying on him.

matches.stipulation: Continental title; Jimmy Stryker guest referee
matches.title: awa-lasvegas-2005-continental
matches.note: Stryker, refereeing, made fast counts and fought both men; he took a swung title belt meant for Rumbler, Rumbler hit his KO on Arnette onto the belt, and with Stryker down Rumbler slammed the referee's hand on the mat for the three.

appearances.note: Opens the show at the desk with Maxwell Williams and later interrupts two matches.
Gives Michael Ryba the opening win from the ring.
Distracts Aspen Jacobs in the Fem-X-billed match with Skylar Black.
Guest referee of Adonis against Rick Young.
In the backstage scene with Jalie Thomas before the Seth Thomas match.

notes: Opens with a backstage scene staged around an unseen visitor at Brandi James's door; the bikini contest is announced as cancelled. The announcer reads Johnny Arnette's billing as the 'RWA Continental Champion.'
